outcome_test.basis: pooled over every goal in the subset, binary home-win indicator

estimator: log-odds ratio of the market's post-goal move to the model's fair move, per goal, on the curated-minute matches whose score reconstruction validates; gated on the market quote actually moving. Primary = median across gated goals. The outcome test pools ALL goals in the subset (gated and not), which is how the published figure was built.
supersedes: the ad-hoc '0.55x / 20 of 22 goals / 7 of 8 matches' figures published before 2026-07-25, which shipped with no estimator; see this file's module docstring
